title: Console test server wait crashes on a non-HTTP reply from a nearby port
description: python/features/steps/console_ui_steps.py _wait_for_server probes the requested port and the next 16 ports. It catches URLError and OSError only, so a port that answers with something other than HTTP raises http.client.HTTPException from _read_status and errors the scenario. Seen on develop CI at agent_assignment_editor.feature:34 on a board-only commit. Catch http.client.HTTPException so the probe moves to the next candidate.
